description: I am a student in Portugal and trying to learn more about space
summary:
In my project, I wrote about some robots, spacecraft and rovers. I explained what they did, when they were launched, their results and their purpose.

It is important to know what previous space instruments did before launching new ones because we can learn from their successes and failures.

This text addresses the challenge because we tell the stories of spacecraft and robots in a simple way so that school students can understand them.
details:
The impact of my project is to help school students understand more about the machinery used in major space advances, such as the Moon landing.

My team and I researched information on websites, wrote our own text and then used AI to improve our language, style and structure.

One of the most important factors that my team and I considered while working on our project was keeping the text simple and easy to understand, so that any school student could learn from it.
